style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

closedDoorRoleAndClearanceReconciliation.scopeOfPass: A future hut can pass its closed-door exterior role while explicitly having no pass-through gameplay claim. qualityCriteria.scoring: Comparative shapeVolume, color, lightingHighlights, materialDetail and artifactFreeReadability scores can support observations. No universal numerical pass mark; material visible defects or missing technical evidence block approval.

rankedVisibleCriteria.outcome: A convincingly constructed compact workshop: thick coherent pitched roof, rounded but disciplined eaves/ridge/chimney, warm timber body with purposeful corner and opening structure. Rebuild awkward strips, proportions, seams and hardware as useful native geometry. Roof, wall and door volumes should be clearer and more deliberate than the source in all four views.
targetCues: Broad roof strip thickness and softened bevels
Substantial navy ridge and chimney collar/cap
Crafted corner posts, door frame and window surround
rankedVisibleCriteria.bounds: Maintain role, palette family, one-cell occupancy, fixed root/camera/semantic doorway and frozen contact/clearance envelope. Source mesh count and exact construction are not locks. Front target is not authority for unseen sides or registration.

rankedVisibleCriteria.outcome: Warm soft form shading and bounded edge highlights explain roof, timber and trim without looking hard-edged, mirror-plastic or flat emissive. Use one horizontally neutral lighting/material treatment across N/E/S/W. Side/rear walls remain readable warm volumes rather than near-black slabs.
reject: Broad black dead spots under roof or on walls
Target-like cyan halo or red alpha flecks

rankedVisibleCriteria.outcome: Keep the cyan/aqua and medium-blue roof, deeper navy structure, honey/orange timber, darker brown frame and golden window/hardware family. Separate roof strips by form and restrained hue/value variation. Timber should feel warm and legible against both cool roof and deck; avoid the source's extremely saturated flat cyan or muddy uniformly brown walls.
rankedVisibleCriteria.judgment: Judge relative relationships and readable color regions rather than exact pixel matching to the target. The plant is a style-only reference, not a required green hue or copied glow.

rankedVisibleCriteria.outcome: Add a small, purposeful set of crafted features such as visible board construction, beveled trim, readable hinges/handle, roof fasteners or window sill. Each should support a workshop identity and survive intended reduction. Wood, roof, metal hardware and warm glass should separate without excessive grain, tiny repeated rivets, random scratches or gratuitous decoration.
rankedVisibleCriteria.freedom: The editor chooses details, topology, normals and shaders; target hardware or exact strip counts are not mandatory. Back/side construction must be coherent rather than copying the front onto every wall.

rankedVisibleCriteria.outcome: At logical128px/cell, phone55.7143px/cell and landscape31.3393px/cell, roof/body/door/window retain a stable hierarchy and a recognizable workshop silhouette. Small hardware may simplify at landscape size, while door and window remain distinct. All4 exact whole frames and repeated copies should remain clean on light/gray/dark backgrounds with current filtering and common world phase.
reject: Clipping, floating trim, coplanar flicker or intersections
Black holes or bright line breaks between intended connected forms
RGB/alpha fringe or bright perimeter halo
Rasters moved or cropped to mimic the target
Invented self-tiling requirement for this freestanding hut
Repeated-detail clutter that overwhelms the silhouette
